ClipboardHistory_Config_Hotkey_Label: Global hotkey to open clipboard history
ClipboardHistory_Config_Hotkey_Desc: Type the combination as text, e.g. Win+V, Ctrl+Shift+V, Ctrl+`. The plugin registers it itself, so Win combinations the host rejects still work. Note: if Windows clipboard history is enabled, Win+V is taken by the system. Applying takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
ClipboardHistory_Config_Keywords_Desc: Type one of these (optionally followed by a filter) to list clipboard history, e.g. "cb token". One per line.
ClipboardHistory_Config_MaxEntries_Desc: Oldest entries are evicted first (pinned entries last). Default 5000, about 6 MB of memory. Restart the host after changing.
ClipboardHistory_Config_RetentionDays_De: Unpinned entries older than this are evicted. Use 0 to disable time-based eviction. Restart the host after changing.
ClipboardHistory_Config_Pause_Desc: Stop capturing new clipboard content (existing history stays searchable). Useful while handling sensitive data.
ClipboardHistory_Config_ShowSource_Desc: Show the name of the process the content was copied from in each entry's subtitle.
ClipboardHistory_Config_CaptureImages_De: Copied or screenshot images are stored as PNG in the plugin data folder (images subfolder), shown as thumbnails in the panel and written back on Enter. Turn off to ignore images.
ClipboardHistory_Config_MaxImageMB_Desc: Images larger than this are skipped. Default 20 MB, range 1-200.
ClipboardHistory_Config_PersistHistory_D: Save history (including full text and images) to history.json in the plugin data folder and restore it on startup. Note: text is stored as plain JSON on local disk; use "Pause capture" for sensitive content. Turn off to clear history on restart.
ClipboardHistory_Config_HoverPreview_Des: Hovering an entry for about half a second opens a flyout with scrollable full text (selectable, Ctrl+C to copy) or a large image preview. Short entries already fully visible in the list do not pop up. Turn off to disable flyouts.
ClipboardHistory_Config_ReminderSound_De: Play the system notification sound when a to-do reminder or pin expiry fires (follows system volume and mute state).
ClipboardHistory_Config_SortTodosByDue_D: Inside the to-do group, sort by due time: the closest reminder rises to the top and overdue items sit at the very top. Turn off to sort by creation time instead.
